coverage_claim: WM-FLW-015 covers one governed Resource Consumption assertion with identity, kind, consumer-resource boundary, interval, qualified quantity, measurement, derivation, allocation, flow components, resource profiles, reconciliation, performance, evidence, governance and loss-aware interoperability. Sector, jurisdiction, billing, accounting, emissions, impact and independent-review questions remain deferred.

boundary_decision.rationale: The root represents one time-bounded source-qualified consumption occurrence or assertion. Frozen standalone-mm describes registry packaging rather than semantic kind.

decisions.rationale: The model owns one use assertion and its derivation lineage rather than a resource, stock, meter or account lifecycle.
Metered, derived, allocated, estimated, modeled, planned and corrected values remain independently typed.
Consumption can participate as a use-side flow in a mass balance, but it is not the complete balance or material-flow system.
Intake, return, discharge, recovery, export and loss treatment must be declared for reproducible net values.
Energy, water, fuel and material domains use different quantity kinds, conversions and flow boundaries.
Meter readings, counter deltas, allocations, estimates, invoices and balances may disagree and cannot use last-write-wins.
Shared-resource allocation, functional unit, denominator and relevant variables require explicit methods and residuals.
They require separate factors, boundaries, methods and authority and cannot be inferred from a physical quantity alone.
Agents may append low-risk assertions and projections but not execute meter control, billing, accounting, regulatory or destructive actions without authority.

decisions.concept: Single-provider waiver and local no-tools audit
decisions.rationale: One bounded Claude Sonnet and one bounded Grok attempt each timed out after 120 seconds. Codex separately audits the frozen validated result and comparison without acquiring new facts, so assurance remains reviewable-draft.

publication_holds: Absence-of-external-review hold: one Claude Sonnet and one Grok attempt for WM-FLW-015 each timed out after 120 seconds; no external result was admitted.
Relation hold: WM-FLW-008 remains a reference rather than an approved parent until joint boundary review.
Boundary hold: resources, stocks, consumers, activities, assets, facilities, meters, observations, invoices, ledgers, emissions, impacts, targets, documents and evidence remain external masters.
Profile hold: energy, water, fuel, material, sector, facility and jurisdiction profiles require exact quantity, unit, flow-boundary and conversion rules.
Measurement hold: meter reading, counter delta, estimate, allocation, invoice quantity, report and authoritative balance remain distinct source-qualified assertions.
Allocation hold: shared use, functional units, normalizers, residuals and uncertainty require declared method, authority and evidence.
Impact hold: cost, emissions, footprint, impact, efficiency and compliance require external methods and accountable decisions.
Reporting hold: GRI and other disclosure projections do not replace operational measurement, inventory, billing or accounting masters.
Interoperability hold: ISO, SEEA, UN/CEFACT, SOSA, SensorThings, QUDT, UCUM, RFC, W3C and GRI projections require exact release pins, conformance tests and semantic-loss declarations.
Completeness hold: the 24-source draft is broad but does not claim universal resource, sector, legal, billing, accounting, environmental or operational coverage.
